retraction.question: A value for Vantorre Group's seats is stated and then corrected. What was first stated, what was the corrected value, and on which lines?

owner_phrases.reading: names the account(s) via who owns/covers/used to own them
owner_phrases.note: Nadia formerly owned Vantorre Group, the industrial account whose seat count Gideon corrects.
